claims.evidence: Photos show used tyres only; no rims/wheels are shown and no origin/Belgium markings are readable.
Tread wear is visually suggested but no tread-depth measurement (mm) or wear gauge is shown.
No close-up of repaired areas/patches is shown; only general tread/sidewall wear is visible.
Bulges would require sidewall/shoulder close-ups from multiple angles; photos do not clearly confirm absence.
No DOT/production date codes are shown/readable to confirm 2023 manufacture.

risks.risk: Wrong tyre size / rim fitment (width/aspect/rim diameter not shown), which can make the tyres unusable or force extra spending.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the tyre sidewall showing the full size code (e.g., 205/55R16) and load/speed rating.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyre-only, unknown size/fitment risk (worst-case: may not match the buyer’s rims).

risks.risk: Age/dry-rot risk (DOT date not shown). Even with good tread, old tyres can fail inspection or be unsafe.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the DOT/production date code on the sidewall (week/year).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially older tyres with possible age-related cracking risk.

risks.risk: Not a matched set (different brands/models/sizes or uneven wear across tyres).
risks.proof: Photos of each tyre’s sidewall showing brand/model (if visible), size code, and a quick tread-depth measurement for each tyre.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed/uneven set until confirmed (worst-case: some tyres more worn than others).

risks.risk: Leak/repair risk (patches, punctures, or internal damage not visible from the shown angles).
risks.proof: Close-up of sidewalls and tread for any repair marks, plus a video of the tyres being inflated/checked for leaks (or a valve-stem close-up).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed leak-free / may require repair.

risks.risk: Safety defects (cuts, embedded objects, bulges, or sidewall cracks) not fully captured in the current photos.
risks.proof: High-resolution close-ups of each tyre’s sidewall and shoulder from both sides, and a tread surface sweep showing any cuts/cord exposure.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially having hidden defects (worst-case: reduced safety/inspection failure).

risks.risk: Quantity uncertainty (how many tyres are available beyond the 4 shown).
risks.proof: A wide shot showing the full count of tyres available.
risks.if_unproven: Price based only on the tyres clearly shown/confirmed in the listing.

proof_requests: Send a clear sidewall photo for each tyre showing the full size code and load/speed rating.
Send DOT/production date code close-ups for each tyre (week/year).
Confirm whether these are tyre-only or include rims/wheels; if wheels are included, show rim photos and bolt pattern/fitment markings.
Provide tread-depth measurements (in mm) for each tyre at multiple points (center and shoulders).
Show close-ups of any suspected repair areas and the entire sidewall/shoulder for cracks, cuts, or bulges.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as used winter/all-season style tyres, but key pricing drivers (exact size/fitment, DOT age, tread depth in mm, and whether it’s a matched set) are not shown clearly enough to price confidently from the current evidence.
